nodes.label: SEMD Auth UI Mockup (Login/Register/2FA)
nodes.rationale: Filename suffix .tmp and an embedded dev-nav debug switcher (Login/Register/2FA Login/2FA Setup buttons) indicate this is a throwaway static HTML prototype, not a wired Next.js page. It establishes the amber/brown brand palette, Thai-language copy, animal mascot branding, and an OTP + QR-code multi-factor auth UX pattern intended to guide later production implementation of the (auth) route group.

nodes.label: SEMD Landing Page Mockup (URL Checker UI)
nodes.rationale: A .tmp static HTML prototype (landing/loading/result page states toggled via JS) for the marketing/checker landing page, establishing the warm color system, mascot branding, hero URL-checker widget, mock report table, and multi-evaluator selection UX ahead of production build.

nodes.label: Class Feature Emphasis Weighting (benign 1.5x, malicious 2.0x)
nodes.rationale: Malicious class strong_features are up-weighted 2.0x vs benign 1.5x to counter class imbalance and push the model to emphasize known malicious signal features (http_token, ip_address_flag, executable_extension_flag, etc.) during training.

nodes.label: SEMD App Logo
nodes.description: Branding mark for the SEMD Next.js companion app. Depicts the wordmark 'SEMD' split into four stacked square/rectangular letter tiles arranged in a 2x2 grid: 'S' (dark brown, top-left), 'E' (tan/gold, top-right), 'M' (navy blue, bottom-left), 'D' (dark brown, bottom-right), each with a subtle drop shadow, on a transparent/white background. Used as the app icon/logo for the browser extension's companion web app.

nodes.label: Register Page Mockup
nodes.description: UI mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) sign-up screen, shown inside a browser chrome frame. Split-screen layout: the left ~55% is a yellow/cream brand panel showing the SEMD logo (a cartoon detective cat with hat and magnifying glass), the tagline 'Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection', and a preview data table of reported URLs with columns ID, URL, Reported at, Type (Malicious/Safe badges), Verify (Checked/Pending badges), and Reported by (avatar + username, including a 'system' entry) — reused as a background/preview behind the auth form. The right ~30% is a white card titled in Thai 'สมัครสมาชิก' (Register) with greeting text 'สวัสดีสมาชิกใหม่ มาเริ่มต้นกันเลย', and a form containing: Username field (ระบุชื่อผู้ใช้งาน) with user icon, Email field (อีเมลล์) with placeholder 'semd@msu.ac.th', Password field (รหัสผ่าน) with masked input and show/hide icon, Confirm Password field (ยืนยันรหัสผ่าน) with show/hide icon, a solid orange 'สมัครสมาชิก' (Register) submit button, a divider labeled 'หรือ' (or), social sign-up buttons for Google ('ดำเนินการต่อด้วย Google') and GitHub, a link 'มีบัญชีอยู่แล้ว? เข้าสู่ระบบเลย' (Already have an account? Log in) pointing to the login page, and a Google reCAPTCHA badge at the bottom. Design uses a warm orange/cream color scheme consistent with the SEMD brand identity.

nodes.label: System API Access Management Mockup
nodes.description: UI mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) admin panel's 'API Access Management' screen (Thai label 'จัดการ API'), reached via the left sidebar under 'จัดการระบบ' (System Management). Shows a summary card '20 API access key ทั้งหมด' (20 total API access keys) and a data table listing API keys with columns ID, Owned (avatar + username, e.g. th33raphat, jame888, natekub), Key (masked, e.g. AIzaSyAIZ***...), Usage (e.g. 50/10000, 5000/10000, 0/10000), Created at, Expired at, and Action buttons ('การใช้งาน' usage view and an edit/pencil icon). Includes a filter control ('+ คัดกรอง') and pagination (Showing: 3, pages 1-99). The sidebar also lists other admin sections: แดชบอร์ด (Dashboard), ข้อมูลส่วนตัว (Profile), จัดการผู้ใช้งาน (User Management), จัดการ API (API Management, currently active/highlighted), จัดการรายงาน URL (URL Report Management), จัดการ Flag (Flag Management), จัดการตัวเลือกวิเคราะห์ผล (Analysis Options Management), and under จัดการ AI: จัดการ Model, จัดการข้อมูลสำหรับฝึกฝน, ตรวจสอบการฝึกฝน Model, จัดการ Queue, System log, plus an ออกจากระบบ (Logout) button.

nodes.label: System User Management Mockup
nodes.description: Admin System Management UI mockup for SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection). Shows the 'จัดการผู้ใช้งาน' (User Management) screen with a left sidebar (Dashboard, Profile, User Management, API Management, URL Report Management, Flag Management, Analysis Option Management, Model Management, Training Data Management, Model Training Inspection, Queue Management, System Log, Logout) and a top bar with admin identity icons (Access Key, TheeraphatStudent, sample_user). Main panel shows 4 stat cards (3 total users, 1 signed up via SEMD, 1 via Google, 1 via Github), a filter control, User/Admin toggle buttons, and a user table with columns User Id, Username, Edited at, Provider, Role, Action. Sample rows: th33raphat (Admin/แอดมิน, SEMD provider), theeraphatstudent (ผู้ใช้ทั่วไป/general user, Github), natekub (ผู้ใช้ทั่วไป, Google), tr33 (ผู้ใช้ทั่วไป, Google). Each row has 'จัดการ' (manage) and 'ลบ' (delete) action buttons, with pagination controls at the bottom.

nodes.label: User API Access Page Mockup
nodes.description: UI mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) 'เข้าถึง API' (API Access) page. Left sidebar has general navigation: แดชบอร์ด (Dashboard), รายงานลิ้งค์ (Link Report), จัดการ Flag (Manage Flag, active/highlighted), เข้าถึง API (API Access, highlighted as current page), ข้อมูลส่วนตัว (Profile), and an ออกจากระบบ (Logout) button at the bottom. Top header shows the SEMD logo/title and icon nav for Access Key, รายงานลิ้งค์, ตรวจ URL, เข้าถึง API, เข้าระบบข้อมูล, GitHub link, and sample_user account icon. Main content area contains a collapsible 'วิธีใช้งาน API' (How to use API) instructions panel, and a table of API keys with columns ID, Key (masked), Usage (e.g. '0 / 10000', '7000 / 10000'), Created at, Expired at, and Action (with 'คัดลอก Key' copy-key and 'การใช้งาน' usage-detail buttons per row). Table toolbar has a filter icon, a '+ คัดกรอง' filter button, and a 'รีเซ็ต Key' reset-key button.

nodes.label: User Access Code Page Mockup
nodes.description: Mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) web dashboard with a modal dialog titled 'รหัสสำหรับการใช้งาน Extension' (Code for using the Extension) overlaid on top. The modal displays a 6-character user access code (e.g. '4AM1ER') shown as individual boxed characters, with a 'คัดลอก' (Copy) button below to copy the code for use in a companion browser extension. Behind the modal, the main dashboard shows the SEMD top navigation bar (dashboard, flag report, URL check, API key, terms of use, GitHub, and user profile icons), a URL/link checker input bar with a 'ตรวจเช็คลิงค์' (Check Link) field and 'ตรวจเช็ค' (Check) button alongside an SEMD ML model selector, and a 'รายงานล่าสุด' (Latest Reports) table listing reported URLs with columns for ID, URL, Reported at, Type (Malicious/Safe), Verify status (Checked/Pending), and Reported by (user or system).

nodes.label: User Dashboard Mockup
nodes.description: UI mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) user dashboard screen. Shows a top navigation bar with the SEMD logo/tagline and icon links (Access Key, Report Link, URL Flag, API Access, Personal Data, GitHub, sample_user). A left sidebar ('การใช้งานทั่วไป' / General Usage) lists navigation items: Dashboard (แดชบอร์ด, active/highlighted), Report Link (รายงานลิ้งค์), Manage Flag (จัดการ Flag), API Access (เข้าถึง API), Personal Data (ข้อมูลส่วนตัว), and a Logout button (ออกจากระบบ) at the bottom, below a user avatar icon. The main content area shows two summary cards ('10 ลิ้งค์ที่ถูกรายงานโดยคุณ' - links reported by you, and '2 ลิ้งค์รอตรวจสอบ' - links pending review), a 'Most Dangerous URLs' panel (URL ที่อันตรายที่พบมากที่สุด) listing top 5 flagged URLs with report counts (e.g. escholarship.org, casamanana.org, songfacts.com, hollywoodlife.com, marketingbyinternet.com), and a 'Prediction Trend' panel (แนวโน้มผลการทำนาย) showing a stacked bar chart of danger/safe/pending classification counts over the last 5 days.

nodes.label: User Profile Page Mockup: SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) UI screen showing left sidebar navigation (Dashboard/แดชบอร์ด, Report Link/รายงานลิ้งค์, Manage Flag/จัดการ Flag, API Access/เข้าถึง API, Profile Info/ข้อมูลส่วนตัว highlighted active, and Logout/ออกจากระบบ), a top nav bar with icons for Access Key, Report Link, URL Flag, API Access, Knowledge Base, GitHub, and a sample user avatar, and a main content area for editing profile: large avatar with 'Edit Profile Picture' and 'Reset Password' buttons, form fields for Username (th33edu), Email (th33raphat@semd.com), Full Name, Date of Birth, Gender dropdown, and an account linking section for connecting Google and GitHub accounts.
nodes.norm_label: user profile page mockup: semd (suspicious-url evaluation for malicious detection) ui screen showing left sidebar navigation (dashboard/แดชบอร์ด, report link/รายงานลิงค์, manage flag/จัดการ flag, api access/เขาถึง api, profile info/ขอมลสวนตัว highlighted active, and logout/ออกจากระบบ), a top nav bar with icons for access key, report link, url flag, api access, knowledge base, github, and a sample user avatar, and a main content area for editing profile: large avatar with 'edit profile picture' and 'reset password' buttons, form fields for username (th33edu), email (th33raphat@semd.com), full name, date of birth, gender dropdown, and an account linking section for connecting google and github accounts.

nodes.label: Prediction Result Page Mockup (Danger)
nodes.description: UI mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) web app's prediction result screen showing the 'danger' outcome state. The top navigation bar shows the SEMD logo/tagline and icons for recent reports (รายงานล่าสุด), link reports (รายงานลิงก์), URL analysis (วิเคราะห์ URL), API access (เข้าถึง API), database access (เข้าถึงฐานข้อมูล), a GitHub link, and the logged-in user 'sample_user'. The main content is a result card displaying the analyzed URL (http://www.eab18fo.epizy.com), the analysis timestamp (2025/09/28 09:00), a prediction label 'เป็นอันตราย' (is dangerous/malicious) styled in red/pink to signal danger, a confidence percentage of 81.05%, a QR code, and a recommendations list advising the user to verify the source's authenticity and avoid clicking the link or downloading files from it. Below the card are two action buttons: 'หน้าหลัก' (Home) and 'แชร์ผลลัพธ์' (Share result).

nodes.label: Prediction Result Page Mockup (Safe)
nodes.description: UI mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) web app's prediction result screen for the benign/safe classification state. Shows a browser-chrome frame with the SEMD top nav (report dashboard, flag report, URL check, API access, knowledge base, GitHub, sample_user profile icons). Below is a result card showing: analysis timestamp (2025/09/28 | 09:00), the analyzed URL (http://www.paulharneygolfcourse.homestead.com/), the prediction label 'ปลอดภัย' (Safe) in green text, a confidence percentage of 99.98%, a recommendations section with safety tips (verify the source destination is legitimate, avoid entering personal info on non-HTTPS sites), and a QR code in the bottom-right of the card. Two action buttons sit below the card: 'หน้าหลัก' (Home/Back) and 'แชร์ผลลัพธ์' (Share Result, blue button).
